capabilities: Track movies, TV shows, games, and books in a unified library view
Fetch cover art, release dates, ratings, and summaries from TMDB, IGDB, and Google Books
Generate media notes from customizable Markdown templates with metadata variables
Check off watched or skipped episodes per TV season
Browse upcoming and recently released media in a calendar view
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. API keys are free but require creating accounts (TMDB account, Twitch developer credentials for IGDB, Google Cloud Console).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a media collection or fetch metadata and cover art for it into notes.
summary: Media library that tracks movies, TV shows, games, and books in one view and syncs their metadata into vault notes.
